pr.title: Give items a priority and filter the list by priority

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_priority.sql has NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal' with a CHECK on the three values. test/priority.test.js 'AC-1' checks existing rows are normal and that 'urgent' is rejected.
test 'AC-2' checks the '— high' and '— low' labels and that normal items have none.
test 'AC-3' covers high, low and normal filters in id order.
test 'AC-4' checks all items are listed in id order with no filter.
test 'AC-5' checks the exact nav markup for all four views, with the current filter in <strong> rather than a link.
test 'AC-6' checks a 400 and no <li> for High, urgent, empty and __proto__. src/index.js uses searchParams.has plus a Set.
test 'AC-7' checks the high, low and normal no-match messages and 'No items yet.' in all four views with an empty table.

findings.what: The final commit 'Follow-up edits' (e1f1183) deleted the 'All priorities' state test. No remaining test checks that the unfiltered view shows no message, which is the 'Message: none' cell of that row. AC-4 checks only the <li> list and AC-5 only the nav. The States table needs a test for every row.
findings.fix:
Restore a state test for 'All priorities'. It should check that every item is listed, that there is no

message and that All is current.

findings.what: The PR says 'Tests deleted or loosened: none'. The last commit deleted the 'All priorities' state test, so the claim is false.
